about.heading: About Me
about.p1: I'm a passionate Fullstack Software Engineer based in Düsseldorf. I currently work at GEBIT Solutions GmbH, where I design and develop software solutions for complex business needs.
about.p2: I hold a degree from Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf and continuously expand my expertise through professional certifications in Java, Spring Boot, Vaadin, Flutter, and other modern technologies.
about.p3: I love turning complex requirements into clean, maintainable code. Whether it's building a Spring Boot microservice, a Flutter mobile app, or a responsive web application — I bring dedication and care to every project.
